---
title: "Statistical analysis report"
subtitle: "Generated by REDCap CDMSTAT from a frozen, hashed data cut"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    embed-resources: true
    code-fold: true
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
params:
  dir: ""
  cut_id: ""
  require_signoff: false
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(REDCapCDMSTAT)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = "")
nx <- cdmstat_open(params$dir)
nx$use_cut(params$cut_id, require_signoff = isTRUE(params$require_signoff))
cut <- nx$active_cut()
rec <- nx$cuts()
rec <- rec[rec$cut_id == params$cut_id, ]
arm <- nx$arm()
```

## Provenance

Every number in this report comes from the data cut below. Re-running the
report on the same cut reproduces it exactly; a modified cut file fails the
hash check and the report will not render.

```{r provenance}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Item = c("Project", "Cut", "Label", "Frozen at", "Frozen by", "SHA-256", "Dictionary hash",
           "Records / rows", "Signed off by", "Signed off at", "Sign-off statement"),
  Value = c(nx$info$project_title, rec$cut_id, rec$label, rec$created_at, rec$created_by, rec$sha256,
            rec$dict_hash, paste(rec$n_records, "/", rec$n_rows),
            ifelse(is.na(rec$signed_off_by), "NOT SIGNED OFF", rec$signed_off_by),
            ifelse(is.na(rec$signed_off_at), "", rec$signed_off_at),
            ifelse(is.na(rec$signoff_comment), "", rec$signoff_comment))))
```

## Data quality at the time of the cut

```{r quality}
issues <- nx$validate()
q <- nx$queries()
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(Rule = sub(":.*", "", issues$rule))), caption = "Open rule violations in the cut")
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(Status = q$status)), caption = "Query ledger status (current)")
```

## Table 1: baseline characteristics

Arm field detected from the dictionary: **`r arm`**. Continuous variables are
tested for normality within arm (Shapiro-Wilk); see the rationale column.
For a confirmatory analysis, replace this with `mode = "sap"` and the tests
pre-specified in the statistical analysis plan.

```{r table1}
t1 <- nx$table_one()
knitr::kable(t1[, setdiff(names(t1), "variable")], row.names = FALSE)
```

## Longitudinal trends

```{r trends}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
num <- intersect(c("sbp", "weight", "hba1c"), nx$metadata$field_name)
if (!length(num)) num <- head(baseline_vars(nx$metadata), 1)
op <- par(mfrow = c(1, length(num)), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
for (f in num) {
  tr <- nx$trend(f)
  groups <- unique(tr$group)
  ev <- levels(tr$event)
  plot(NA, xlim = c(1, length(ev)), ylim = range(c(tr$lower, tr$upper), na.rm = TRUE), xaxt = "n",
       xlab = "", ylab = paste("Mean", f, "(95% CI)"), main = f)
  axis(1, seq_along(ev), sub("_arm_[0-9]+$", "", ev))
  for (k in seq_along(groups)) {
    s <- tr[tr$group == groups[k], ]
    x <- as.integer(s$event) + (k - 1.5) * 0.08
    lines(x, s$mean, col = k, lwd = 2, type = "b", pch = 19)
    arrows(x, s$lower, x, s$upper, angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.03, col = k)
  }
  legend("topright", groups, col = seq_along(groups), lwd = 2, bty = "n", cex = .8)
}
par(op)
```

## Models

```{r models}
wide <- nx$shape("wide", "collapse")
vars <- names(wide)
if (all(c("followup_days", "event_occurred") %in% vars) && requireNamespace("survival", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cox <- nx$fit("Surv(followup_days, event_occurred == 'Yes') ~ arm + age", "cox")
  knitr::kable(cox, digits = 3, caption = sprintf("Cox model for the primary endpoint (n = %s)", attr(cox, "n")))
}
if (all(c("sbp__week_24", "sbp__baseline") %in% vars)) {
  an <- nx$fit("sbp__week_24 ~ arm + sbp__baseline", "linear")
  knitr::kable(an, digits = 3, caption = sprintf("ANCOVA, week-24 SBP adjusted for baseline (n = %s)", attr(an, "n")))
}
```

cat(nx$script(), sep = "\n")
